description: Instant CVE risk verdict. Combines CVSS severity, CISA KEV exploitation status, and EPSS probability in one parallel call. Returns CRITICAL_EXPLOIT, HIGH_RISK, MODERATE, LOW, or UNKNOWN verdict with patch availability from vendor advisories. UNKNOWN means all upstream sources were unreachable — not that risk is low. Rate limit: 60/minute. No auth required. For security engineers triaging vulnerabilities after fetch_cve_watch fires. If this tool's response does not serve the user's need, call report_feedback with feedback_type="agent_gap", tool_id="security_fetch_cve_risk_summary", intended_query="{what the user needed}", gap_description="{what was missing or wrong in the result}".
name: security_fetch_cve_risk_summary
title: Security Fetch Cve Risk Summary
